stem: What issue was President Truman referring to in this address?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: C
options.text: Initiating a naval blockade on China

options.label: D
options.text: Competing in the space race with the Soviet Union

visual_elements: Excerpt from President Harry Truman, farewell address, January 15, 1953: But after all this was said, we realized that the issue was whether there would be fighting in a limited area now or on a much larger scale later on—whether there would be some casualties now or many more casualties later. . . . Our men are fighting as valiantly as Americans have ever fought—because they know they are fighting in the same cause of freedom in which Americans have stood ever since the beginning of the Republic.
